blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— A Change.Org petition has been launched seeking improved mobile phone signal and internet connectivity at the Batangas Passenger Terminal, citing passengers’ growing reliance on digital services while traveling. The petition, titled “Improve Mobile Signal and Internet Connectivity at Batangas Passenger Terminal,” calls on the Philippine Ports Authority (PPA), terminal operator Asian Terminals Inc. (ATI), Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT), National Telecommunications Commission (NTC), and telecommunications companies Globe Telecom, Smart Communications, and DITO Telecommunity to coordinate efforts to address weak and unreliable connectivity inside the terminal.
